checkpointProof.qualification: Seven independent comparisons bind the cold original owner state, exact complete selected proposal, acquired event, retained source fact, exact command/observation/outcome transition, and capture cursor immediately after each selected record. Only selected Symbols prefixes are covered; foreign-prefix checkpoint conservation is not asserted. Missing legacy captures are not counted as a checkpoint proof.
